title: RelayPairingRequest
description: The body of `POST /relay/v1/pairing` (ADR 0230 §6): the relay agent's new Ed25519 public key, asking for a device code. It names no id: the relay draws one when the owner enters the user code, and a request that names one is refused as an extra field. The request is signed with the key it pairs (`Relay-Signature`), which proves the agent holds it.

protocol.description: The protocol the agent speaks: 1 for this contract.

agent_version.description: The agent's own release, as a fact to show.

signing_key.description: Ed25519, raw 32 bytes, base64url without padding: verifies every later hello of this installation. The private half never leaves the installation.
